findings.summary: MAX_PARALLEL load-average parse is wrong in BOTH locales, and as of this tick it is the SOLE determinant of DEGRADED.

measured.fr_FR_parse_result: 2  (splits on the DECIMAL comma; truncates to integer part)
measured.LC_ALL_C_parse_result: 2.112.833.08  (no commas present; concatenates all three averages)

findings.why_it_matters: Both failure modes fail OPEN (toward MAX_PARALLEL=max_parallel_default=4), never toward throttling: the truncated integer is always <= true load, and the concatenated string never satisfies a numeric > comparison.
findings.newly_reachable: Previously masked. When pressure_mode=legacy (every tick through 06:30Z) HEADROOM_MB was forced null so DEGRADED was true regardless of load. This tick pressure_mode=adaptive AND container_vm_headroom_mb=5128 >= headroom_floor_mb=1500, so the headroom half no longer degrades and the load half alone decides.
findings.correction_1: SUPERSEDES the recorded advice 'pin LC_ALL=C on Step 5.1'. Pinning LC_ALL=C is what PRODUCES the concatenation — it removes the commas the -F',' split depends on.
findings.correction_2: SUPERSEDES this dispatcher's own 06:30Z commit body (1b6586533), which claimed 'the fault is the field separator, not a decimal-comma locale' and that 'LC_ALL=C changes nothing'. That test was invalid: LC_ALL=C had already been exported before the comparison was run, so C was being compared against C. It is BOTH faults and they interact.
findings.verified_fix_direction: Split on whitespace after -F'load averages?:' and normalize the decimal comma. Verified to yield 2.11 under BOTH fr_FR.UTF-8 and LC_ALL=C: uptime | awk -F'load averages?:' '{print $2}' | awk '{v=$1; gsub(",",".",v); print v}'
findings.owner_hint: agent-father (flow-doc edit, docs-only, no runtime code)

findings.summary: Two independent consumers both fail to reach the same live carry.regime field, for two different reasons. Single upstream fix serves both.
findings.consumer_a: cowork telemetry.md Step 6.0 — looks up key 'regime_status', which has never existed in the snapshot schema.
findings.consumer_b: alert-commander via .claude/skills/regime-extraction/SKILL.md — parses macro_snapshot.text for a 'Global Liquidity: X' line. Confirmed absent: grep for that literal across all 42 on-disk snapshots returns zero files. Live .text is now '[Macro Snapshot]/Status: ok/Vn Index: ...'.
findings.consumer_b_behaved_correctly: The SKILL carries a documented 2026-07-03 schema-drift note instructing exactly this fallback (REGIME=NEUTRAL + log, read CARRY_REGIME from signals.carry.regime). alert-commander followed it. This is not an agent error — but the fallback has now been the standing behaviour for ~7 weeks and that note itself says 'flag to dev-team/architect if seen repeatedly'.
findings.fix_direction: Point both consumers at macro_snapshot.data.signals.carry.regime, or have the snapshot writer surface a top-level regime_status. Do NOT fix only the promotion path and call the adaptive inputs revived.
